title: Ability | OMS
cardSubtitle: Modernizing legacy enterprise workflows through UI redesign and responsive interfaces.
summary: I helped transform Ability Commerce's legacy order management system into a modern, responsive web application. My work ranged from hand-drawn sketches and Adobe XD designs to implementing interface updates with Angular, TypeScript, and Bootstrap. I worked with developers in Agile sprints, using Jira to track tasks and issues.

title: Bookt / InstaManager
cardSubtitle: UI/UX design for an all-in-one vacation rental management platform.
summary: Bookt began as a startup with a vision to simplify the vacation rental industry by bringing reservations, accounting, marketing, maintenance, property management, and customer-facing websites together into one connected platform.

I helped build the company's creative identity and digital experiences from the ground up, from branding and marketing to enterprise UI/UX applications and custom client websites. As Bookt evolved into InstaManager, the company was ultimately acquired by RealPage.

title: Kigo / RealPage
cardSubtitle: Connecting acquired applications and shaping Kigo's next chapter through creative design & development.
summary: Following RealPage's acquisitions of Bookt / InstaManager and Kigo, I contributed to the platform's evolution through hands-on UI/UX design, front-end development, and creative problem-solving.

My work included integrating acquired applications, refining navigation across modules, designing additional application interfaces, developing client-facing websites and custom WordPress plugins, and supporting the eventual RealPage branding transition.
This period also introduced me to more structured design and development processes, including Agile/Scrum workflows, Jira, Sketch, and style guides.

title: Ability | POS
cardSubtitle: Redesigning point-of-sale workflows for a modern, responsive checkout experience.
summary: I helped redesign Ability Commerce's legacy point-of-sale system into a modern, responsive interface. I spent time in retail stores using actual checkout stations to understand cashier workflows, then applied those insights to sketches, wireframes, and UI designs.
I worked with developers to create a more intuitive checkout experience across devices.
problemsSolved: Simplified everyday checkout tasks and navigation.
Improved the flow for payments, returns, and customer lookups.
Redesigned the interface for different screen sizes.
